story.title: First Meeting
story.body: A chance encounter at an art exhibition in Riyadh brought two souls together. What started as a conversation about calligraphy became the beginning of forever.

story.title: The Journey
story.body: Through shared dreams, late-night conversations, and adventures across the Kingdom, their bond grew deeper with each passing day.

story.title: The Proposal
story.body: Under the stars of AlUla, with the ancient rocks as witness, Ahmed asked the question that would change their lives forever. She said yes.

guestbook.author: Fatima Al-Rashid
guestbook.message: May your love story be as beautiful as the stars over AlUla. Congratulations!

guestbook.author: Omar Hassan
guestbook.message: Two amazing people finding each other. Wishing you a lifetime of joy and laughter!

guestbook.author: Lina Khalid
guestbook.message: So happy for both of you! Can't wait to celebrate this beautiful union.
